# EggerMath - Free GBA Emulator
> Play classic Game Boy Advance games for free in your browser. No download needed. Powered by mGBA WebAssembly. Pokemon, Zelda, Mario, Metroid & 25+ GBA titles. Instant play, save states, fast forward.

## How to Play
- Go to https://www.eggermath.com
- Click any game or drag-and-drop your own .gba/.zip/.gb/.gbc ROM
- Controls: WASD/Arrows = D-Pad, K = A, J = B, Q = L, E = R, Enter = Start, Right Shift = Select, F5 = Save, F9 = Load
